title: Add RAG templates and agent tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Added RAG and agent quickstarts, example templates, and docs site navigation updates. No breaking changes.
description: This PR adds a set of opinionated RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) templates and a set of agent/tool-calling quickstarts and examples aimed at making it easy for engineers to adopt RAG and tools within Redwood. Motivation: customers repeatedly ask for battle-tested quickstarts that combine vector search, prompt templates, and tool-calling examples; having canonical examples reduces onboarding friction and prevents anti-patterns. What this PR includes: 1) RAG quickstart doc with step-by-step instructions for dataset ingestion, vector store selection, and template examples for zero-shot and few-shot prompts; 2) two agent examples demonstrating tool-calling patterns: a TypeScript movie-info agent (tools for HTTP lookup and cache) and a Python mail-search agent that wires up Redwood embeddings plus a simple vector DB; 3) updated docs site navigation and examples index; 4) small SDK README updates to surface the quickstarts. Changes are documented and linked from the docs site, and the quickstarts include runnable snippets and Docker compose for local testing. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG quickstart doc and templates - [x] Add agent tool-calling examples (TS + Python) - [x] Update docs site navigation and examples index - [x] Include CI doc-build and example tests - [x] Add minimal smoke tests for examples Notes on compatibility and migration: examples are additive and non-breaking; they reference current stable SDKs and pin example model names to documented model aliases. Testing: examples include unit-style smoke tests that run in CI using a lightweight local vector store emulator; doc-build added to site pipeline. Related Linear: ENG-4573. Requesting reviews from docs and examples owners for copy and accuracy.
